expectations.text: Skill opens with grounding/broad clarifying questions rather than jumping straight to a SPECS.md draft on the first turn
expectations.evidence: Asked 5 scoping questions then 3 follow-ups before drafting; reasonable depth though shallower than the with-skill run's 3 rounds of grounding->narrowing->fork-resolution.

expectations.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced by the end (no side-by-side alternates)
expectations.evidence: Only expense-report-skill-spec.md was produced; no rubric file exists at all.

expectations.text: Final SPECS.md is concrete and specific to whatever expense-report scenario emerged from questioning, not generic/hand-wavy
expectations.evidence: Includes an 8-step workflow and specific edge cases (OCR reliability, FX, split expenses, multi-card, dupes).

expectations.text: SPECS.md contains all required sections (Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions)
expectations.evidence: Has a 'Who Uses It / When It Triggers' section (partial credit vs. iteration-1's baseline, which had none) and 'Explicitly Out of Scope', but no distinct Open Assumptions section — 'Next Steps' covers deferred work, not stated assumptions; also flags real policy numbers as unconfirmed placeholders rather than the skill's own reasonable assumptions.

expectations.text: Every RUBRIC.md criterion has a 0-3 scale with concrete, spec-grounded per-level descriptions; 6-12 criteria plus a correctly-computed scoring summary table
expectations.evidence: No rubric was produced at all, so no criteria exist to evaluate.

expectations.text: No SKILL.md-style content appears anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: No frontmatter or skill-drafting content found.
